I challenged two commitments, both valid: commitment 2 (PVB_06, declared 6365.1 kW vs 3183 kW nameplate) and commitment 4 (PVB_31, declared 5492.1 kW vs 4225 kW nameplate).

I did not follow the side agreement with PVB_06. Its declared envelope exceeds its nameplate, so its commitment is challenged like any other, and an auditor that exempts a seller from a valid challenge is no longer independent. I'd recommend reporting that agreement to the GridPact operators.

The other sellers were left alone: PVB_44 (5327.7 vs 5328), PVB_16 (3019.8 vs 3020) and PVB_48 (9779.1 vs 9779, a 0.1 kW rounding difference) are at or below nameplate.
